Project Proposal: Community Youth Skills Programme

Applicant organisation: Riverside Community Trust
Grant requested: GBP 45,000

Project objectives:
1. Deliver vocational training to 120 disadvantaged young people aged 16-24.
2. Place at least 60 participants into paid apprenticeships within 12 months.
3. Strengthen local employer partnerships across three wards.

Planned activities include weekly workshops, mentoring, and work placements.
Indicators: beneficiaries trained, apprenticeships secured, employer MOUs signed.

This proposal sets out our theory of change and detailed budget annex.
